currentCounters.baseEligible: count of scoreCandidate results with basePassed===true
currentCounters.rrEligible: count of scoreCandidate results with rrPassed===true
currentCounters.channelCounts: count of final scoreCandidate ok results by A/B channel
currentCounters.exclusions: first failure reason under fail-fast gate order
currentCounters.conditionDistribution: A/B check distribution over basePoolDiagnostics = every feature row whose final result has basePassed===true

rrPassedTrueFor: signal-grade-C reject after RR already passed
exactRrPassedBoundary.notEquivalentTo: number that pass RR if RR were independently evaluated

keyFalsification.statement: baseEligible -> rrEligible is not an RR funnel step.
keyFalsification.why: Between those flags lie financial/data completeness, event risk, valuation, sector, setup, fundamental quality, ATR, target availability and RR.
keyFalsification.consequence: The difference baseEligible - rrEligible cannot be attributed to RR, target, or any single gate.

conditionDistributionScope.computes: A/B technical check pass/fail directly for all denominator rows
conditionDistributionScope.consequence: A.fullPass/B.fullPass counts are technical-state prevalence inside the early-admitted population, not counts of rows that actually reached the A/B gate in Formal order.

poolSemantics.topLevelDiagnostics: The first selector loop runs over all featureRows, including >=1000 THOUSAND names.
poolSemantics.thousandStockPool: Then THOUSAND rows are evaluated again for a dedicated sub-report.
poolSemantics.consequence: Top-level baseEligible/rrEligible/channelCounts/exclusions are COMBINED-universe diagnostics, not GENERAL-only diagnostics. THOUSAND sub-report is a subset, not an additive separate denominator.
poolSemantics.generalQualifiedNotDirectlyCounted: generalTop.length is capped selected count, not total GENERAL fully-qualified count.

historicalInterpretationGuard: Do not interpret baseEligible 513 -> rrEligible 9 as RR removing 504 names.
Do not interpret A.fullPass+B.fullPass as rows that reached the setup gate.
Do not add top-level diagnostic counts to thousandStockPool counts; that double-counts THOUSAND names.
Do not infer GENERAL qualified population from generalTop/generalCandidates because it is quota-capped.

requiredFunnelReceipt.perRow: PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN / NOT_EVALUATED for independently evaluable states, plus firstFailureReason
requiredFunnelReceipt.denominators: exact count by scanDate × pricePool × state
requiredFunnelReceipt.transitions: ordered reached/pass/fail counts separate from independently observable gate states
